# `layout.auto_fill`

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs-gen` from crates/ew-commands/schemas/layout.auto_fill.schema.json. Do not edit: change the source and regenerate. -->

`layout.auto_fill` (`AutoFill`, WP-S4.02 D6, FR-LAY-013): places a list of devices on a rail, next-fit from the
rail start, in one step; placed items never move.

`devices` defaults to the unplaced devices of the rail's layout space whose primary part fits the rail's profile.
`order` is `dt` (the natural order of the full tag) or `schematic` (the page order of the main representation,
then the row and the column of its anchor cell; devices without one last, by tag). The unplaced members of one
assembly travel as one block (at their minimum gaps, in `member_order`) at the place of the first of them in that
order. Each item goes to the first left edge at or after the previous item's end plus the minimum gap where it fits
with every minimum gap (`next_fit`); an unknown footprint is the 20 mm square. A device that is not placed is
named in a notice, one per device in list order: "-102F1: already placed", "-K9: not in this rail's layout
space", "-UC1: not mountable", "-X5: TS 32 does not fit a TS 35×7.5 rail", "E55: screw-mounted, not on a rail",
"-201U9: no room left on rail 3".

Rejected: a carrier that does not exist (`/carrier`); a duct ("Auto-fill works on a rail."); a listed device that
does not exist or is listed twice (`/devices/i`); nothing placed at all ("Nothing was placed on rail 1: " and the
notices). Interactive; `Bulk` above 200 devices in the list. Outcome: the carrier, with the notices.

| `carrier` | [`CmdUuid`](#cmduuid) | yes |  | The rail. |
| `devices` | array of [`CmdUuid`](#cmduuid) or `null` | no |  | The devices to place; default the unplaced devices of the rail's space that fit it. |

## Types

### CmdUuid

A lower-case hyphenated UUID naming a record (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: string (at least 36 character(s), at most 36 character(s))

Pattern: `^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$`

### FillOrder

The order `layout.auto_fill` places its devices in (WP-S4.02 D6).

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `"dt"` | The natural order of the full device tag. |
| `"schematic"` | The page order of each device's main representation, then the row and the column of its anchor cell; devices without a main representation last, by tag. |

## Exit codes

A command runs as one line of a command log replayed by `ew apply` ([doc 17 §3.5](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/17-extensibility.md#35-command-logs-ewcmd)). The exit code of `ew apply` is:

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | The line committed as one transaction. |
| 1 | A prevent rule or the command's own domain rule refused the line (`Prevented`, `Rejected`); without `--one-step` the lines before it stay committed and are saved, with `--one-step` nothing is saved. |
| 2 | Anything else stops the replay: invalid parameters, a missing record, an unresolvable reference, an open, lock or save error. |

The codes of every subcommand are in [doc 17 §3.2](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/17-extensibility.md#32-exit-codes).
